thesis: Evidence quality is strong after the Orchestrator pass. Decision-critical historical inputs now have cutoff-valid primary support for AI-first ARR scale, debt maturities/liquidity, repurchase execution and Semrush consideration. The uploaded normalized extract remains a partial supplementary pack rather than a replacement financial dataset. The key unresolved evidence gap is economic, not accounting: Firefly-specific inference margin and AI-first ARR incrementality are still undisclosed.

evidence.claim: Q3 8-K/earnings materials directly report revenue, ARR, OCF, repurchases, AI-first ARR growth and Q3 balance-sheet figures.
Q2 10-Q directly reports debt maturities, $1.5B undrawn revolver, commercial paper, H1 OCF/R&D/capex/SBC and Semrush acquisition details.
FY2025 10-K supplies annual OCF/R&D/capex, purchase obligations and Q4 repurchase execution needed for TTM/four-quarter estimates.
Q2/Q3 Adobe earnings scripts directly disclose >$500M then >$650M AI-first ARR and Firefly/MAU adoption metrics.

counterevidence: AI-first ARR is company-defined; exact product composition and incrementality are not disclosed.
Firefly-specific inference cost, gross margin and contribution margin were not found.
Several domain observables (TTM absorption, owner-style FCF/share, four-quarter repurchase price) are calculations from primary facts rather than directly reported metrics.
The user-provided normalized extract is partial and explicitly insufficient for several core financial statements.
unknowns: Firefly-specific inference gross margin or contribution margin.
Same-definition long-run retention/market-share data for core creative workflows.
falsifiers: A cutoff-valid filing contradicts a frozen source fact or reveals a definition mismatch material to a score.
A future filing restates the primary data used in TTM or repurchase calculations.

key_kpis.name: primary-source coverage
key_kpis.threshold: all score/veto observables trace to filing or company IR

key_kpis.name: definition continuity
key_kpis.threshold: AI ARR/Firefly definitions reconciled before trend inference

Any restatement or definition change requiring refreeze.
